entry.title: Nepenthe 1.0.2
entry.summary: Published under the author's name: the plugin's maker is now **ikloX**, so its folder is `ikloX - VST - Nepenthe` (it was `OpenMPC - VST - Nepenthe`). No DSP change — the reverb is identical to 1.0.1. - `install.sh` removes the old folder for you. If you copied the folder by hand, delete the old one so the plugin is not listed twice. - The plugin's uid is unchanged, so saved projects keep their instances (checked on an MPC Live). - The skin carries a small author's mark in the bottom-left corner

entry.title: Nepenthe 1.0.1
entry.summary: Nepenthe 1.0.1: Amalgamated Signals' velvet-noise reverb (https://amalgamatedsignals.com/nepenthe) as an MPC OS insert effect. Upstream's six controls and slider look, six Q-Links: TIME, DELAY, BASS, TREBLE, WIDTH, MIX. The reverb is upstream's code; its inner loops are rewritten in NEON and checked bit-identical to the original. - `Nepenthe-1.0.1-mpc-armv7.zip`: Gen1 (Live, Live II, One, X, Key 61/37, Force). Tested on an MPC Live, MPC OS 3.10.1. CPU: mean 10.0 %, p99 10.8 % of an audio block w
